new.s: Who among the following first put forward the idea of a Constituent Assembly for India in 1934?

new.s: In which year did the demand for a Constituent Assembly become an official demand of the Indian National Congress?

new.s: Which party's National Executive demanded in 1946 that the Constituent Assembly be dissolved and re-elected by universal adult suffrage?

new.s: Why was the Constituent Assembly criticised as not being representative of the people?
o: Its members were indirectly elected under the restricted franchise of the 1935 Act
It was dominated by the Muslim League
Its members were nominated by the Governor-General
new.x: Its members were elected indirectly by provincial assemblies chosen on the limited 1935 Act franchise, not by adult franchise.

new.s: Where was the first headquarters of Andhra University when it was established in 1926?
new.x: Andhra University began in 1926 with its headquarters at Vijayawada (Bezawada); it moved to Waltair, Visakhapatnam, in 1930.

new.s: Which university was established on 26 April 1926 as the first university for the Telugus?
new.x: Andhra University, set up under the 1925 Act, was established on 26 April 1926 and is the oldest university in today's AP.
new.angle: U0256 #55 Andhra University -> year of establishment

new.s: Which of the following towns was NOT among the rival claimants for the seat of Andhra University before Visakhapatnam was chosen in 1928?
new.x: Vijayawada, Rajahmundry and Anantapur claimed the seat; Kurnool was not a claimant.
new.angle: U0256 #59 Rival claims for the university seat

new.s: In whose house at Mylapore, Madras, did Potti Sriramulu undertake his fast unto death in 1952?
new.x: The fast began on 19 October 1952 and was held at Bulusu Sambamurthy's house in Mylapore.

new.s: Which leader began a fast unto death on 19 October 1952 for a separate Andhra State?
new.x: Potti Sriramulu began his fast on 19 October 1952 and died on its 58th day, 15 December 1952.
new.angle: U0256 #5/#68 Potti Sriramulu's fast -> start date

new.s: On which day of his fast did Potti Sriramulu die?
new.x: He died on the 58th day of his fast; 35 days was Swami Sitaram's fast and 29 days his own Wardha fast of 1948.

new.s: Of which organisation's first session, held at Jogipet in 1930, was Suravaram Pratapa Reddy the president?
new.x: The Nizam Andhra Mahasabha began at Jogipet (Medak) in 1930 under Suravaram Pratapa Reddy.
new.angle: U0256 #32 Nizam Andhra Mahasabha -> first president

new.s: As Chief Minister of Andhra State, Bezawada Gopala Reddy represented Andhra in which agreement?
new.x: Bezawada Gopala Reddy represented Andhra in the Gentlemen's Agreement of 20 February 1956 with Telangana leaders.
new.angle: U0256 PYQ yf83003bdda5 Gentlemen's Agreement -> Andhra representative

new.s: Which was the first Telugu newspaper, started at Bellary in 1835 by Christian missionaries?
new.x: Satyadoota (1835, Bellary) was the first Telugu paper; Hitavadi (1841) was the first printed in Andhra.
new.angle: U0258 #2 First Telugu newspapers -> year + place

new.s: Where was Satyadoota, the first Telugu newspaper, published in 1835?
new.x: Satyadoota was brought out at Bellary by Christian missionaries in 1835.

new.s: Which was the first political journal in Telugu, started in 1885?
new.x: Andhra Prakasika (1885) of Parthasarathy Naidu was the first political journal in Telugu.
new.angle: U0258 #1/#2 Newspapers -> founder + year (first political journal)

new.s: Who founded Andhra Prakasika (1885), the first political journal in Telugu?
new.x: Andhra Prakasika was founded by Parthasarathy Naidu, not P. Anandacharlu.
